directions.name: The Harvest Desk
directions.thesis: A calm editorial opening with a clear contact panel; enquiry topics sit underneath.
directions.benefit: The fastest route to the confirmed email and phone number. A compact topic guide helps visitors explain their needs.
directions.tradeoff: Every enquiry starts through email or phone; this does not create a website message inbox.
structure: Split introduction and direct contact panel
Three equal enquiry-topic choices with shared guidance
directions.motion: 140ms topic-selection colour feedback; no hero animation.
directions.mobile: Heading, contact panel, topic choices and guidance stack in that priority.

directions.name: A Letter to WeGroween
directions.thesis: A structured email draft gives a visitor a little help putting their question into words.
directions.benefit: Best when messages need context, especially produce preferences and restaurant quantities.
directions.tradeoff: More effort than a direct contact page. This preview prepares an email draft; a native send form would need a separately chosen delivery service.
structure: Four-field email draft with direct contact details beside it
directions.motion: 140ms focus and error feedback; draft region appears without movement.
directions.mobile: Direct email and phone remain visible above the form; fields stack vertically.

directions.name: The Kitchen Guide
directions.thesis: A short, useful question guide sits alongside direct contact, with an enquiry action for each topic.
directions.benefit: Helps visitors understand what information to include before contacting the business.
directions.tradeoff: Requires more content discipline; keep answers specific and avoid becoming a long FAQ page.
structure: Three question accordions beside direct contact
directions.motion: Native details expansion; no animated height or scroll hijacking.
directions.mobile: Direct contact first, then the three questions.

constraints: No production source edits, dependencies, backend, deployment or messages sent.
No invented opening hours, response times, exact farm address, delivery coverage, certifications or harvest schedules.
No invented Facebook or YouTube URLs; show their current unlinked labels only in the shared footer.
No new palette, typography or visual language. Existing selected paper artwork remains elsewhere; contact information leads here.
interactionContract: Gallery switches comparable structures. Topic buttons update guidance and email subject. Draft form validates locally and produces a mailto link without sending or storing data. FAQ uses native keyboard-accessible details. No-JS exposes all three directions and direct contact links.

research.confidence: High for supplied contact details and current route state; visitor preference is a design hypothesis, not user-research evidence.
